models.name: Model 3
models.alt: Grey Tesla Model 3 viewed from the front quarter
models.best: A strong starting point if a lower seating position and a conventional sedan footprint suit your day.
models.tradeoff: Try rear-seat access, the boot opening and your usual luggage. A spec-sheet volume does not describe the shape of the opening.
models.test: Bring the actual child seat or suitcase. Test visibility, controls, ride comfort and parking on familiar roads.

models.name: Model Y
models.alt: Grey Tesla Model Y parked outside, viewed from the front quarter
models.best: Start here for a higher seating position and a liftback that makes bulky everyday loads easier to trial.
models.tradeoff: Seat count and packaging vary by version. A seven-seat or long-wheelbase claim must match the exact local configuration.
models.test: Check the rear seat with the front seat in your driving position, loading height and the space you actually park in.

models.name: Cybertruck
models.tag: A job first. A statement second.
models.alt: Stainless-steel Tesla Cybertruck parked at dusk
models.best: A candidate when the pickup bed and truck-specific requirements are central to the purchase.
models.tradeoff: Measure garage and parking clearances, check local availability and verify payload and towing against the actual vehicle and trailer.
models.test: Test access, visibility, load handling and the route you would tow. Budget for the extra energy demand of the real job.

models.name: Model S
models.alt: Blue Tesla Model S parked beside trees
models.best: An alternative to explore in the used market if you want a larger low-slung liftback.
models.tradeoff: Large differences exist between generations. Identify the exact year, battery, drive unit, suspension, infotainment and driver-assistance hardware.
models.test: Inspect the underbody and service history, test every powered function and obtain repair and insurance quotes for that specific car.

models.name: Model X
models.alt: Grey Tesla Model X viewed from the front quarter
models.best: A used-market alternative when a larger cabin and an appropriate seating layout are priorities.
models.tradeoff: Seating configurations, door systems, warranty and hardware depend on the individual car. Do not treat every Model X as the same product.
models.test: Operate the falcon-wing doors in a suitable space, check seat mechanisms and verify all fitted equipment before agreeing a price.

sources.note: US federal credits are unavailable for vehicles acquired after 30 September 2025. Earlier qualifying acquisitions have separate conditions.

sources.name: EPA/DOE fuel economy ratings
sources.note: Use the exact certified model and configuration. EPA, WLTP and real-world journey range are different measures.

checklist.title: Measure parking
checklist.text: Check vehicle dimensions, access, door clearance and the place you will charge.

checklist.title: Try real passengers
checklist.text: Fit child seats and test entry, headroom and the actual seating configuration.

checklist.title: Test the difficult trip
checklist.text: Map a winter or motorway journey with realistic charging stops and a reserve.

checklist.title: Confirm a charging plan
checklist.text: Obtain a home/workplace solution or price the public charging routine you would really use.

checklist.title: Capture the exact configuration
checklist.text: Keep year, trim, drive, wheels, paint, options and VIN where assigned.

checklist.title: Get an itemised quote
checklist.text: Include taxes, fees, accessories, delivery charges and only confirmed incentives.

checklist.title: Read the finance contract
checklist.text: Compare rate, total payable, deposit, term, any balloon and early-settlement terms.

checklist.title: Price insurance before ordering
checklist.text: Use the exact model and your circumstances, not an average online example.

checklist.title: Check title and history
checklist.text: Follow your local ownership, finance, damage, recall and mileage checks.

checklist.title: Ask about battery evidence
checklist.text: A displayed range or charge percentage alone is not a battery-health certificate.

checklist.title: Inspect condition independently
checklist.text: Check tyres, brakes, suspension, glass, underbody, charge port and both AC/DC charging where practicable.

checklist.title: Confirm warranty and equipment
checklist.text: Verify the actual warranty, software entitlements, hardware and service records.

checklist.title: Inspect the car before acceptance
checklist.text: Record damage, gaps, glass, wheels, lights and included equipment through the seller’s process.

checklist.title: Test the essentials
checklist.text: Check locks, keys, windows, seats, heating, cooling, cameras and charging.

checklist.title: Complete account handover
checklist.text: Check app ownership, access, payment setup and the transfer status for a third-party purchase.

checklist.title: Keep the documents
checklist.text: Save the contract, warranty, inspection findings, issue references and insurance confirmation.
